title: Three Breaths of Life and Death
next_chapter_hook: The lingering fragrance of that elixir still danced upon his lips, yet an icy chill seized Chen Ji's heart—for the seven-day deadline had arrived in the blink of an eye, and soon he would face yet another life-or-death抉择.

text.content: Just as jubilant cheers shook the great hall, a withered, iron-lean figure emerged slowly from the shadows at the entrance—the Five Elders' leader had finally appeared. The old man's beard and hair were entirely white, his facial skin clinging to his bones like dried bark, yet his clouded eyes concealed piercing brilliance. As his gaze swept across the hall, the air seemed to crystallize into an invisible frost. "I have been in seclusion for many years, yet I never imagined the sect had degenerated to such a state," the aged voice rang out, not loud but clearly reaching everyone's ears. "A servant disciple, worthy of standing beside the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged as he bowed his head in deference, his voice reverent to the point of abjectness: "Disciple greets the Fifth Elder. Disciple merely followed orders; if there was any offense, I pray the Elder will pardon it." As he spoke, he sank even lower, his shoulders trembling slightly, radiating utter terror. Only in the depths of those downcast eyes did a cold light flicker and vanish.

text.content: Yet at that moment, Chen Ji's chest suddenly seized with pain. The fragment embedded in his dantian quivered violently, as if something was being forcibly drawn away. His vision swam black; the spiritual energy within him gushed outward like a breached dam. "Cough—" A mouthful of blood choked from his lips, blooming startling crimson against that pallid face.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao had been coldly observing the Elder's pressure, but upon seeing Chen Ji spit blood, her pupils constricted sharply. She stepped forward, supporting his swaying form, and for once her voice carried a rare urgency: "Chen Ji! What happened to you?" She looked down at his clutched chest; wherever her fingertips touched, it was scorching hot beyond reason.

text.content: Chen Ji forced himself to steady his stance, pushing Su Qingyao's hand away as he murmured: "It's nothing, merely an old ailment relapsing." But he knew this was no ordinary ailment—the backlash from the Tianji Record had arrived as predicted. Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed hauntingly in his mind: "Within three breaths, you still have three hours. After those three hours, without something to sustain your life, even Hua Tuo returned from the dead couldn't save you."

dialogue.content: "An old ailment?" Su Qingyao's gaze was like a blade as it swept across Chen Ji's face. She coldly demanded: "Chen Ji, do you take me for a three-year-old?" She suddenly reached for his pulse gate. Chen Ji tried to evade, yet discovered he had no strength left. When those slender fingertips touched his searing skin, Su Qingyao's expression transformed completely.

text.content: "This is... Heavenly Fate backlash?" Su Qingyao's voice was pressed extremely low, low enough that only Chen Ji could hear. She stared into his eyes, her gaze flickering with complex, indecipherable light: "Who exactly are you? Where did the thing on your body come from?" The truth she had painstakingly investigated for three years now seemed within arm's reach.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji offered a bitter smile, blood trickling down the corner of his mouth: "Senior Sister Su, some things... knowing them would only bring misfortune." He raised his head to look toward the Fifth Elder's direction; that withered figure was slowly approaching, each step carrying an suffocating pressure. "I have no time to explain now, but I need Senior Sister to help me with one thing."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji faced a life-or-death choice, and Su Qingyao's interrogation put him in a dilemma—revealing the truth might expose his identity, yet refusing to answer could mean missing his only chance at survival.

choices.description: Reveal the truth about the Tianji Record Fragment and its backlash to Su Qingyao in exchange for her full assistance, but the cost would be the complete collapse of his carefully craftedtrash persona built over three years.
choices.visible_cost: Three Years of Camouflage Destroyed in an Instant
choices.visible_reward: Gain Su Qingyao's trust and obtain elixirs
choices.risk_hint: Once exposed, there would be no place for him within the Tianqing Sect

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, his voice as low as a mosquito's buzz: "Has Senior Sister ever heard of... the Tianji Record?" The moment these five characters left his lips, Su Qingyao shuddered violently, her eyes blazing with sudden intensity. Without giving her time to react, Chen Ji continued: "The fragment on my body is devouring my lifespan. After three hours, barring any miracles, I will drop dead on the spot."

dialogue.content: "You're mad!" Su Qingyao hissed, yet she seized Chen Ji's wrist and produced a jade bottle from her bosom. "This is the Nine-Turn Revival Elixir I acquired by chance—I was saving it for breaking through my bottleneck..." She gritted her teeth, pressing the jade bottle into Chen Ji's palm. "Take it. Consider it... repaying the debt from when you saved me that time."

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶得知天机录真相并献出丹药

choices.description: Only reveal that he suffers from an incurable illness and needs an elixir to sustain his life, concealing the existence of the Tianji Record to maintain his surfacetrash persona, but this might fail to gain Su Qingyao's complete trust.
choices.visible_cost: May not obtain the best-quality elixir
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the camouflage; the elixir's effects may be diminished
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao's suspicions will grow heavier; she may interrogate him again in the future

text.content: Chen Ji gently shook his head, his expression despondent: "Senior Sister, please don't ask. I simply... have a naturally frail constitution, struck by some curse." He forced a bitter smile. "If Senior Sister has any life-sustaining elixirs, Chen Ji would exchange any price for them." This statement was half-truth, half-false—it explained the symptoms while hiding the most critical secret.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao narrowed her eyes, her gaze deep and unfathomable: "A curse?" She clearly didn't believe it, yet seeing Chen Ji's teetering state, she ultimately refrained from pressing. She drew a emerald-green elixir from her sleeve—lustrous in color, yet permeated with a faint, if lingering, bittersweet scent. "This is my bottom-of-the-trunk Blood-Purifying Elixir. It can extend life by seven days. After seven days, if you haven't found a radical cure..."

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶只知陈机身患绝症，不知天机录存在

choices.description: Refuse Su Qingyao's help, preferring death over exposing any secrets, allowing the purge to continue and争取死前完成更多布局.
choices.visible_cost: Death within three hours is certain
choices.visible_reward: Maintain perfect camouflage; reputation will rise after death instead
choices.risk_hint: All arrangements will come to nothing; Chen Nian will have no one searching for her

text.content: Chen Ji stepped back, evading Su Qingyao's reaching hand. A serene smile bloomed on his ashen face: "I thank Senior Sister for her kindness, but this illness... has no medicine to cure it." He turned toward the Fifth Elder's direction; his back appeared especially desolate in the sunset's glow. "Some things are more important than living."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao froze. She had never seen someone treat life and death so nonchalantly, never seen anyone face death so calmly before her. In that instant, something in her heart crumbled. She grabbed Chen Ji's wrist and forcefully pressed the jade bottle into his palm: "Swallow it! That's an order!"

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶强行塞药，对陈机态度剧变

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his gaze to the gentle elixir in his palm; his fingertips trembled slightly. The moment the elixir touched his throat, a cool sensation spread along his meridians, and the burning pain in his chest gradually receded. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again: "The elixir is taking effect. The seven-day deadline... is enough time for you to accomplish much."

dialogue.content: "Thank you, Senior Sister." Chen Ji clasped his fists solemnly. When he rose, his stance had steadied considerably. His gaze toward Su Qingyao carried an indefinable complexity: "This kindness, Chen Ji will remember." He paused, lowering his voice: "In seven days, regardless of what happens, Senior Sister need not come looking for me. If I'm gone by then... take care of someone for me."

text.content: Su Qingyao's brow furrowed tightly. Just as she was about to press for answers, she saw the Fifth Elder had arrived nearby. The withered old man glanced at Chen Ji's pallid complexion, then at the jade bottle in Su Qingyao's hand, and a meaningful smile curled at his lips: "The Inner Disciple Senior Fellow secretly hoards spiritual medicine to rescue a servant disciple... quite interesting indeed."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's face turned to ice: "What does the Fifth Elder mean by this? Does a disciple need to report to an Elder when helping a fellow disciple?" Her aura suddenly surged, appearing entirely different from moments before. "Moreover, Chen Ji rendered great service in the great hall today. I will not stand idly by if anyone is in distress." The words were firm, yet her clenched fists betrayed her inner unease.

choice.prompt: The Fifth Elder's targeting caused the situation to deteriorate sharply. Chen Ji had to make a choice—continue playing the protectedtrash, or take the initiative to break the impasse.

choices.description: Stand in front of Su Qingyao, proactively drawing the fire onto himself, demonstrating responsibility while also showing the Fifth Elder he is no pushover.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the Fifth Elder's anger
choices.visible_reward: Establish prestige before everyone, enhancing reputation
choices.risk_hint: If the Fifth Elder acts rashly on the spot, the consequences could be dire

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath and stepped forward, positioning himself before Su Qingyao. Though his complexion was pallid, he stood ramrod straight; those eyes, always downcast, met the Fifth Elder's gaze directly for the first time: "If the Elder has complaints, direct them at this disciple alone. Senior Sister Su merely acted out of compassion, unable to bear watching this disciple die before her."

dialogue.content: His voice was not loud, yet every word rang clear, echoing through the silent hall. The surrounding disciples cast gazes of surprise or admiration—one and all. Was this still that dociletrash servant disciple? The Fifth Elder narrowed his eyes; his withered fingers tapped lightly on his walking staff: "Now that's interesting..."

choices.memory_label: 陈机当众挑衅五长老，众人刮目相看

choices.description: Maintain a humble posture, using self-humiliation to deflect the Fifth Elder's attacks, leaving the opponent without a pretext to strike, while secretly observing the Fifth Elder's true intentions.
choices.visible_reward: Cause the Fifth Elder to lower his guard, creating opportunities for a counterattack later
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may become even more suspicious

text.content: Chen Ji's body shuddered; he dropped to his knees, his forehead striking the blue stone floor heavily: "This disciple is guilty! This disciple, emboldened by a few minor achievements, dared to attach himself to Senior Sister Su—truly blinded by greed! The Elder's criticism is justified; this disciple dares not again!" His voice was mournful, his posture abject to the extreme.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao trembled with rage, yet she saw Chen Ji's kneeling figure tilt slightly, winking at an angle only she could perceive. In that instant, she suddenly understood. She drew a steadying breath and coldly declared: "Since this servant disciple knows his error, I won't stoop to his level. If the Fifth Elder has no further instructions, this disciple takes her leave."

choices.memory_label: 陈机自污保身，苏青瑶心照不宣

text.content: The Fifth Elder squinted, studying this pair of senior and junior disciples for a long moment. Then, suddenly, he burst into hearty laughter. That aged, rasping laughter echoed through the spacious hall, making people's scalps prickle. "Interesting, interesting. The Tianqing Sect has languished for many years; finally, some interesting figures have emerged." He turned toward the doorway, his withered silhouette stretching into a long shadow in the sunset. "See you at the Sect Competition in seven days. I shall look forward to seeing what tricks you can muster."

dialogue.content: Only after the Fifth Elder's figure vanished entirely did Su Qingyao heave a long sigh. She gazed down at Chen Ji, still kneeling on the ground; a complex expression flickered in her eyes. "Rise," she said, her voice regaining its usual cold detachment, though the icy distance between them had lessened. "The seven-day deadline— what do you plan to do?"

text.content: Chen Ji slowly rose, brushing the dust from his knees. That habitual gentle smile reappeared on his face, yet deep within his eyes lay a depth even Su Qingyao could not fathom. "Seven days... is enough." He gazed toward the setting sun at the horizon, his voice light as a whisper: "Enough time to accomplish a great many things."

choice.prompt: Though the purge had temporarily subsided, the death countdown of the seven-day deadline hung like a sword over his head. Su Qingyao's interrogations, Chen Nian's whereabouts, the completion of the Tianji Record... everything awaited Chen Ji to uncover.

choices.description: Use the remaining time to frantically search for his sister Chen Nian—this was the core objective of his many years of arrangements. Even with only seven days, he would fight with all his might.
choices.visible_cost: May not have time to address the Tianqing Sect's internal crisis
choices.visible_reward: If Chen Nian is found, the completion of the Tianji Record may bring a turning point
choices.risk_hint: With only seven days, time is tight; there may be mishaps

text.content: Chen Ji turned to gaze into the distance—that was the direction of the Holy Sect. His fingers unconsciously rubbed the jade pendant at his waist—the only keepsake Chen Nian had left him. "Little Nian, wait a little longer for me," he silently vowed in his heart. "Within seven days, Brother will definitely find you."

choices.memory_label: 陈机决心在七日内找到陈念

choices.description: Seek aid from the Demonic Path Saintess Ye Qing; her Demonic Path mists can conceal the aura of the Tianji Record, perhaps finding a method to cure the backlash entirely.
choices.visible_cost: May owe a favor to the Demonic Path
choices.visible_reward: Demonic Path secret arts may be able to alleviate the backlash
choices.risk_hint: If involvement with the Demonic Path is exposed, the consequences would be unimaginable

text.content: Chen Ji drew a black transmission talisman from his sleeve. With a surge of spiritual energy, the talisman transformed into flowing light and vanished into the horizon. A slight smile curved his lips: "Lady Ye Qing, it's time we discussed cooperation." A moment later, a haunting voice resounded in his mind: "Oh? Has Young Master Chen finally decided to meet me?"

choices.memory_label: 陈机主动联络魔道圣女夜清

choices.description: Delve into the interior of the Tianji Record, get straight to the point with the guardian Mo Xiansheng, and demand he provide a method to completely resolve the backlash—even if the price is unlocking more secrets prematurely.
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng's answer may not be what he wants to hear

text.content: In the still of night, Chen Ji returned alone to the Servants' Quarters. He closed his eyes, focused his mind, and plunged his consciousness into his dantian. The fragment materialized once more; Mo Xiansheng's phantom flickered into visibility within the golden light. "You came," the aged voice carried a sigh. "The seven-day deadline—is this your visit to ask about a solution?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji did not waste words: "Mo Xiansheng, how did Chen Xuan of old resolve the backlash problem? I refuse to believe he simply sat and waited for death every time." Mo Xiansheng was silent for a long while; his phantom trembled slightly: "He... found a way. But that way carried a cost far greater than you can imagine."

choices.memory_label: 陈机与墨先生对质，得知陈玄曾找到解决之法

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew from his Mental Sea. When he opened his eyes, the eastern sky was already blushing with dawn. He stood before the window, watching the light gradually strengthen at the horizon, and his heart had already formed a resolution. The seven-day deadline, seemingly brief, was enough for him to stir up this murky water. "Ling Yuan, the Fifth Elder, and that lofty Eye of Heavenly Providence..." he murmured, a cold, savage arc curling at his lips. "Since you all love to play chess, allow me to teach you what it means to turn clouds into rain with one hand, and rain into clouds with the other."

dialogue.content: He draped his outer robe and pushed open the door. The frigid morning wind brushed past his cheeks, bringing a bone-deep chill. Yet in his heart blazed a raging fire—the flames of revenge, and also the desperate desire to survive. "First thing, go see Su Qingyao," he自语道. "For the Sect Tournament in seven days, I need her cooperation." He paused, a flicker of tenderness crossing his eyes. "And also... there are some things I should tell her."

text.content: The lingering fragrance of that elixir still danced upon his lips, yet an icy chill seized Chen Ji's heart—for the seven-day deadline had arrived in the blink of an eye, and soon he would face yet another life-or-death choice.
